body_markdown:
### More Than Hardware: Materials Drive New Opportunities


The evolution of industrial SLA isn't just about printers. Materials have played an equally important role in expanding what manufacturers can achieve.


Over the years, Somos® materials have helped move SLA beyond traditional prototyping applications and into increasingly sophisticated engineering workflows. Today's materials are delivering the durability, dimensional stability, impact resistance, and performance characteristics required for functional testing and production-related applications.


A recent example is[Somos® Resolute Grey®,](https://www.stratasys.com/en/materials/materials-catalog/stereolithography-materials/somos-resolute-grey/) a premium engineering-ready SLA material developed for demanding mechanical testing environments. Designed to provide high-impact resistance, long-term durability, dimensional stability, and snap-fit performance, it enables manufacturers to create highly detailed parts with an excellent surface finish directly from the machine, reducing post-processing requirements and accelerating development cycles.
